description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificate files, initializing SSL contexts, and handling verification. It is part of a WebSockets encryption helper module.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and configuration for WebSocket clients, including certificate management and SSL context initialization.

methods.name: TlsEnabled
methods.description: Constructor that logs creation of TLS-enabled WebSocket.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the certificate file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the private key file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate files for verification.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handler for the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines and sets the authentication success based on TLS connection state.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SSL context for TLS connections.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context, or defaults if none specified.
